query: How is the Joint PhD program with SOAS structured over time?
reference_answer: Students typically spend their first months building a literature review and research plan, aiming to upgrade from MPhil to PhD status within 9 months of starting. query: I'm an EEE student minoring in Physics. Do I need to separately meet the Physics minor's prerequisites even though I'm not a Physics major?
reference_answer: Yes - BRACU's Minor in Physics has its own defined set of required courses and prerequisites, separate from your EEE major requirements, open to students from other departments as long as they meet those specific prerequisites. Being an EEE major doesn't automatically satisfy the Physics minor's course requirements; you'd need to check and fulfill them independently.
